## Summary

**CMP** (Compare): Subtract & use only the condition.

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `Dn – Bn → cc` |
| Syntax | `CMP Bn,Dn` |
| Short | Subtract & use only the condition. |
| Description | Subtracts the source from the destination and sets the condition codes according to the result. Size is long. |
| Condition codes | see table |

### Condition codes

| X | N | Z | V | C |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| – | * | * | * | * |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–12 | `1100` |
| 1 | 11–9 | Dn |
| 1 | 8–3 | `110000` |
| 1 | 2–0 | Bn |

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have CMP. This page covers only the 68080 addition: CMP with a B address register as source. For the classic forms, the Motorola manual applies.

## Do / Don't

- No rules beyond the details above.
